page.overview:
Who is Moondancer?

Trained originally in fast jets, then converted to space. Secondment to Action Force and further strategic training have made Moondancer a top-rate space combat technician.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" ! colspan="2" style="border:1px solid black" |Action Force Second Generation

Moondancer was a part of the 1984 wave of Action Force toys. He was a repaint of the 1983 Short-Fuze (swivel arm). Also packed with the Triad Fighter V2. ----

Appearance: yellow hair; light grey shirt with black straps (one horizontal) and black sleeve pockets; light grey belt and pants with black pockets and black boots with light grey highlights
